g.text: L1 DURABLE AGENT WORKFLOW ENGINE
triggerdotdev/trigger.dev
★ 16,815 · 1,541 forks · TS · Apache-2.0
• Build & deploy long-running AI agents and
background workflows with zero serverless timeouts
• Checkpointed state, retries & human waitpoints
• Full Docker/Kubernetes self-hosting support
Best for: Durable Multi-Step Agent Execution
L2 FULL-STACK MCP APPS & SERVERS
mcp-use/mcp-use
★ 11,005 · 1,560 forks · TS · MIT
• TypeScript framework to build, test & ship MCP
servers, ChatGPT plugins & Claude connectors
• Native interactive Views & MCP Apps support
• Built-in visual MCP Inspector & agent client
Best for: Interactive MCP UI Apps & SDK
L3 3,000+ WEB DATA ACTORS MCP
apify/apify-mcp-server
★ 17,698 · 483 forks · TS · MIT
• Connects AI agents to 3,000+ Apify Actors for
structured web, social, maps & e-commerce data
• Dynamic Actor discovery & schema translation
• Supports Streamable HTTP, SSE & stdio
Best for: Enterprise Market & Web Data Ingestion
L4 OFFICIAL AWS CLOUD MCP SUITE
awslabs/mcp
★ 9,947 · 1,895 forks · Python · Apache-2.0
• Official AWS Labs suite of specialized MCP
servers (CDK, Terraform, Cost, Bedrock, EKS)
• Enforces Well-Architected & security guardrails
• Grounded cloud pricing, docs & IaC synthesis
Best for: Multi-Cloud AWS Architecture & FinOps
END-TO-END DURABLE AGENT ORCHESTRATION, MCP APPS UI & CLOUD/WEB DATA PIPELINE (L1 ➔ L4)
1. Interactive MCP App Frontend (mcp-use ★11.0k): Ship typed MCP servers with embedded interactive UI Views inside Claude/ChatGPT & web apps.
2. Durable Background Execution (trigger.dev ★16.8k): Run long-horizon agent tasks with checkpointed retries, queues & human approval tokens.
3. Structured Web Data Extraction (apify-mcp-server ★17.6k): Invoke 3,000+ specialized Actors for external market, pricing & competitor signals.
4. Cloud IaC & FinOps Automation (awslabs/mcp ★9.9k): Audit cloud costs, query Bedrock KB & synthesize Well-Architected CDK/Terraform code.
CLOSED-FORM FINOPS TCO MODEL (45-ENGINEER FULL-STACK AI & CLOUD PLATFORM TEAM · SYNTHETIC WORKLOAD MODEL)
• Path A (Commercial Workflow SaaS + Custom MCP UI Boilerplate + Proprietary Cloud Ops): $4,920.00/mo + 46.5h ($4,650.00) = $9,570.00/mo
• Path B (Azure Durable Functions + Azure MCP + Managed Connector PaaS): $1,910.00/mo PaaS + 10.5h ($1,050.00) = $2,960.00/mo
• Path C (trigger.dev + mcp-use + apify-mcp-server + awslabs/mcp): $75.00/mo Compute + 2.4h ($240.00) = $315.00/mo (Saves $9,255.00/mo · -96.71%)
